data.name: String Theory
data.detailed_description:
StringTheory is a guitar practice game that turns your own song library into playable challenges. Import supported song files (or use the included songs), pick a part, and play along while the game listens to your instrument in real time with live single-note and chord detection. Your performance is scored as you play..

Built for both learning and replay, StringTheory lets you load your own songs and work on them your way. Use Loop Mode to repeat difficult sections, Note By Note Mode to stop at each note or chord until you hit it, and speed controls to slow songs down while you learn. In addition to real instrument gameplay, the game also includes a rhythm mode for supported chart formats, with keyboard and gamepad support. Whether you want to drill one solo, practice rhythm parts more cleanly, or just play through your favorite charts, StringTheory is designed to make practice faster, clearer, and more fun.

Key features

  • Play with a real guitar or bass using live single-note and chord detection

  • Earn a score based on how accurately you perform

  • Import your own songs from supported chart and notation formats

  • Create and edit your own charts in the built-in editor, with a live 3D preview, guitar techniques, beat mapping, and tone switches

  • Use Loop Mode to repeat any section for focused practice

  • Use Note By Note Mode to stop at each note or chord until you play it

  • Adjust playback speed to learn difficult passages more easily

  • Includes a rhythm/arcade mode with keyboard and gamepad support

  • Connect an electronic drum kit over MIDI and play full drum charts, with every pad mapped from kick to crash

    Note: Real instrument note detection requires an audio input device or microphone. A direct instrument cable or low-latency audio interface is recommended for the best experience.

    Note: Local multiplayer requires a game controller for the second player.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560 / Intel Arc A380 or equivalent DirectX 11 GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
  • Additional Notes: Microphone, instrument cable/interface (recommended), or compatible audio input device required for guitar/bass note detection features.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
